name: Sample phone (invented)
frame: An invented device, not a real product. Origin at the centre of the phone's outline, on the back. +X to the right seen from the front (the edge with the side button and the touch strip), +Y to the top edge, +Z from the back (z = 0) to the front glass (z = 10). The camera plateau and lens stand out of the back, towards -Z. 'From the top' t is y = 65 - t.

sample.title: Invented numbers of the sample phone. No such device exists: nobody makes or sells it and nothing was measured
sample.note: Stands in for a maker's drawing in examples and tests. The numbers define the sample device, so they count as its standard. They describe no real product: never build a case for a real phone from them.

sample_estimate.title: Invented numbers of the sample phone that play the part of sizes scaled off a drawing
sample_estimate.note: They show how a number the maker does not state is tagged (guessed) and asked about.

width.note: Excludes the buttons, which add 0.6 per side.

corner_profile.note: All four corners: points as (distance from the side edge, distance from the end edge). Not a circular arc.

corner_lead_in.note: Where the straight edges resume, measured from the corner. The body outline does not use it.

edge_profile.note: All sides: points as (inward from the side, height from the mid-plane, both ways). The body has these rounded shoulders on the back and on the front.

cover_glass.note: Front glass outline; it starts 1.5 in from the housing edge all round. Nothing may touch it.

display_active.note: Display active area; 3 from the housing edge all round, which is also where the flat front face starts.

features.label: Mode button

center.note: Assumed centred in the thickness like the side button.

features.question: Is the middle of the mode button 5 mm from the back? The sample states where it is along the edge and how large it is; the 5 mm is an assumption. Compare with the phone, or print that opening alone.

features.label: Volume up

center.note: Assumed centred in the thickness like the side button.

features.question: Are the middles of both volume buttons 5 mm from the back? The sample states where they are along the edge and how large they are; the 5 mm is an assumption. Compare with the phone, or print those openings alone.
features.note: The gap to the volume down button is 4.

features.label: Volume down

center.note: Assumed centred in the thickness like the side button.

features.question: Are the middles of both volume buttons 5 mm from the back? The sample states where they are along the edge and how large they are; the 5 mm is an assumption. Compare with the phone, or print those openings alone.

features.label: Side button
features.note: Stands 0.6 proud, centred in the thickness.

features.label: Touch strip

flare.note: The sample does not say from which line the angle counts; it is taken from the surface's normal.

features.question: Does a finger reach the whole touch strip through the case? The opening is 22 x 10.8 mm at the surface and widens by 40 degrees, here taken from the surface's normal because the sample leaves the reference line open. Try it on a test print of that side.
features.note: Flush with the edge. A case opening is 22 x 10.8 at the surface with R3 corners and a 40 degree flare all round; 10.8 is wider than the 10 body, so the opening breaks through both faces.

features.label: Receiver slot

center.note: Slot centre 2 from the top edge, read as the middle of the keep-out.
The keep-out runs from 1.5 to 2.5 from the top edge.

features.question: Is the receiver slot free below the top lip? The sample states a band to keep free, 1.5 to 2.5 mm from the top edge; that the slot is in the middle of it, at 2 mm, is an assumption.
features.note: A top lip must not reach more than 1.5 in from the top edge across the middle 18.

features.label: Front camera
features.note: Inside the display; a lip never reaches it.

features.label: USB-C receptacle

center.note: Centreline 4.6 from the back; which face it counts from is not stated.

features.question: Does a plug go into the USB-C receptacle with the case on? Its centreline is taken as 4.6 mm from the back; the sample gives the 4.6 mm without naming the face. Look at the phone before you print the bottom wall.
features.note: Connector keep-out: 13 x 10.6 with R5 corners, outward 16. It is taller than the 10 body, so a bottom wall cannot bridge over the port: it must be an open notch.

features.label: Bottom microphone 1
features.question: Are the microphones and ports beside the USB-C receptacle open with the case on? Their centres are taken as 4 mm from the back; the sample gives the 4 mm without naming the face. Look at the phone before you print the bottom wall.

features.label: Bottom microphone 2
features.question: Are the microphones and ports beside the USB-C receptacle open with the case on? Their centres are taken as 4 mm from the back; the sample gives the 4 mm without naming the face. Look at the phone before you print the bottom wall.

features.label: Bottom port 1
features.question: Are the microphones and ports beside the USB-C receptacle open with the case on? Their centres are taken as 4 mm from the back; the sample gives the 4 mm without naming the face. Look at the phone before you print the bottom wall.

features.label: Bottom port 2
features.question: Are the microphones and ports beside the USB-C receptacle open with the case on? Their centres are taken as 4 mm from the back; the sample gives the 4 mm without naming the face. Look at the phone before you print the bottom wall.

features.label: Camera plateau

end_profile.note: The ends are flattened curves, not semicircles: points as (distance from the bar's end, distance from its centre line); straight between the ends.

blend_limit_y.note: The concave blend from the plateau to the back ends 37 from the top across the middle and curls up to 32 near each side.

blend_side_y.note: Where the blend ends at the lines 3 in from each side: 32 from the top.

blend_straight_x.note: Half the width over which the blend's lower edge is straight.

features.question: Does the camera plateau fit the case's opening? Its 60 x 20 mm top face, the shape of its ends and the blend around it are estimates; its height (2.5 mm) and what is on it are stated. Print the opening alone first, or measure the plateau with a caliper.

features.label: Rear camera

length.note: Back to rear camera glass (2 above the plateau).

center.note: The cone's apex on the lens axis.

features.question: Are the corners of a picture dark with the case on? The lens keeps an 80 degree cone free, and where the tip of that cone is, is not certain. Take a test picture.

features.label: Flash

diameter.note: Where the 70 degree cone ends: 5 + 2 x 1.5 x tan(35 deg).

features.question: Does the case catch light from the flash? The sample's outer cone to keep free (150 degrees, from 1.5 to 3.5 mm above the flash) is not certain, so a lip around the plateau stays low there.

features.label: Area of uniform case thickness on the camera plateau
features.note: Where a case covers this area its thickness must be uniform, and no thicker than the back limit.

features.label: Area of uniform case thickness below the camera
features.note: On the back just below the camera plateau's raised surround, 19 to 33 above the centre. Where a case covers this area its thickness must be uniform: no edge of an opening, no rib and no step should cross it.

features.label: Magnet ring

field_span.note: From 30 to 45 below the ring centre.

features.note: Inside the 60 circle no metal, conductive or magnetic material. Plain TPU, PETG and PLA are unaffected.

features.label: Compass
features.note: Keep magnets and magnetic material away; the 1.0 diameter only marks the spot.

max_back_thickness.note: Case thickness on the back: 2.4 max, uniform.

min_glass_standoff.note: Exposed glass shall not come within 0.7 of a flat surface with the case on.

usb_c_opening_min.note: A USB-C opening shall be at least 12.5 x 9; 13 x 10.6 is recommended.

dock_max_bottom.note: At most 2.2 from the phone's bottom to the outside of the case.

touchscreen_opening_deg.note: The case opens at 100 degrees along the edges of the active area.
